headline: Election of chairperson and vice-chairperson, plus appointments to committees, legal counsel, and school physician.
summary: Officers will take the oath of office and elect a chairperson and vice-chairperson. Later items name officers and committees, including the Belonging Advisory Committee and the Finance Committee Rotation List.
items: Oath of office, given by the City Clerk
plain_text:
AGENDA 
 
Bangor School Committee 
Organizational Meeting 
11:00 a.m., Monday, November 9, 2026 
City Hall Council Chambers 
 
Pathways to Excellence 
 
 
   
Call to Order 
 
Flag Salute  
A.  Oath of Office - City Clerk     
 
B.  Election of School Committee Officers: 
      1.   Chairperson 
      2.   Vice-Chairperson 
 
C. Code of Ethics 
 
D.  Designation of Officers and Committees: 
      1. Attendance Officers 
 2. Affirmative Action Officer 
 3. Title IX Coordinator 
 4. Wellness Committee 
 5. Committee Appointments 
       a.  Representatives to United Technology Center 
  b. Belonging Advisory Committee 
      6.   Negotiations Subcommittee 
7. Dropout Prevention 
8. Policy Committee 
      9.   Finance Committee Rotation List 
      10. School Physician 
     11. Legal Counsel 
 
Adjournment       
 
Reminder: Workshop on November 12, 2025, at 5:00 pm. Regular meeting starts at 7:00 
pm in Council Chambers. 
 
The Bangor School Committee meets the Second and Fourth Wednesdays of each month to conduct its business 
as elected officials charged by the Bangor City Charter with the care and management of the public schools. 
They acquit their statutory powers and duties only when lawfully assembled.
